purpose: The repo's setup script needs a tool that only its declared image installs. In a container the audit builds that image and the app reaches Level 2. With no container runtime, the missing tool is a limit of the machine: the shared install is blocked, the app's own frozen install runs so its checks still run on the host, Level 1 stays blocked, and the report says the declared image installs the tool.

runs.name: no container runtime
runs.coverage: On this machine pricegen is not installed, an environment limit rather than a repo defect; the declared image installs pricegen\.
